name: @extas/search
description: Storefront search (S02 · PR 72, 73): one engine behind a small adapter — Meilisearch when the server has it and its index is current, the shop's own PostgreSQL catalogue otherwise — with prefix, typo and synonym matching, phrases, general words and Bengali keywords from settings; the help-page matcher; the catalogue's search documents and their version; the indexer the background worker runs (idempotent: one version is indexed once).
